description: This file contains shell script functions to initialize, setup, and teardown a MBIM protocol for network interfaces in OpenWRT. It defines configuration functions, interface management procedures, and interactions with the 'umbim' utility for modem communication.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the protocol configuration parameters for MBIM, setting default values and adding configuration options.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field value from the MBIM configuration output.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM interface, attempting to establish connection with retries on failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM interface, disconnecting and cleaning up the protocol state.
